arguments.sql: SELECT t.transaction_type AS transaction_type, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) GROUP BY t.transaction_type ORDER BY t.transaction_type
arguments.explanation: Shows the fraud rate for each transaction type (chip, online, swipe) over labelled transactions, with the count of labelled transactions behind each rate.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only; unlabelled transactions are excluded rather than treated as legitimate.
The three types are taken as the values 'Chip Transaction', 'Online Transaction' and 'Swipe Transaction' in transactions.transaction_type.
